content:
# 上传图文视频

请求地址：[https://ad.e.kuaishou.com/rest/openapi/gw/dsp/upload/atlasPhoto](https://ad.e.kuaishou.com/rest/openapi/gw/dsp/upload/atlasPhoto)

请求方式：POST

数据格式：JSON

### 请求参数

| 字段         | 类型   |  是否必填   | 说明   | 备注                        |
| ------------ | ------ |  ------ | ------ | --------------------------- |
| advertiser_id | Long |  必填 | 广告主ID |  |
| pic_ids | String[] |  必填 | 图片ID | 封面使用第一张图片 |
| audio_bs_key | String | 可选 | 音频bs_key | [音频上传接口获取](https://developers.e.kuaishou.com/docs?docType=DSP&documentId=2382)|
| shield_backward_switch | Boolean | 可选 | 上传视频后是否自动同步至快手个人主页, 默认false      |   |
| wait_for_transcode | Boolean | 可选 |  用同步/异步方式上传视频,默认false  |  |

### 返回参数

| 字段         | 类型    | 说明                        | 备注         |
| ------------ |  ------ | --------------------------- | ---------- |
| data | Object  |  |  |
|  photo_id | String | 图文视频ID  |  |
| code | Integer |   |  |
| message | String |   |  |

### 请求样例

```js
curl --location 'https://ad-star-gateway-api-beta.corp.kuaishou.com/rest/openapi/gw/dsp/upload/atlasPhoto' \
--header 'Access-Token: [REDACTED_SECRET_EXAMPLE]' \
--header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
--data '{
    "advertiser_id": 139494,
    "pic_ids": [
        "5215449848999249535",
        "5220516399508008924",
        "5206724126146862162"
    ],
    "audio_bs_key": "55a4aebd6b544b6aa4ac99ef9c004c18",
    "shield_backward_switch": false,
    "wait_for_transcode": false
}'
```

### 返回样例

```
{
    "code": 0,
    "data": {
        "photo_id": "5254293505944748162"
    },
    "message": "OK",
    "request_id": "EO60gICQgpGOChiqBSC_pPnDsjEorfyysww="
}
```
